text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy grounds at dusk looking for Symboli Rudolf—

I saw Symboli Rudolf heading up
the stairs leading to the rooftop with a rather severe expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
…………An Umamusume I recently raced against
is retiring from the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Word has it—faced with my running,
they lost their confidence and could run no longer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...This isn't the first time. For the exact same reason,
I've watched the backs of many leave before now."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Every time I witnessed their regrets,
I made a fierce, steadfast vow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, through this running of mine,
I shall embody our ideals and standards—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To bring about a world where many Umamusume can find happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yet on the other hand, a thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Stacking up victories, standing at the summit,
and trying to save the Umamusume... That is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Wondering if this was nothing more than my own ego.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I questioned myself time and time again. And each time,
I concluded that the path I was walking was the right one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have always believed that at the end of this road,
a future where they are truly rewarded awaits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …………I tried to believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There is a question I must ask you now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What do you—
think of my dream?
choice_data_list: You're worrying about that at this point?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What do you—
think of my dream?
choice_data_list: You're worrying about that at this point?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ......You really have no hesitation, do you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I might have spent a bit too much time... looking back over my shoulder today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I let you walk ahead of me, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun,
would you shake my hand once more?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Please, watch over me,
so that I do not lose my way—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I want you by my side.
I take her outstretched hand and respond with a firm squeeze.

And then—
she gave me a gentle, subtle smile.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Ghk.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're absolutely...
right, you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Even though the only one who can prove the rightness of my path
is myself, who walks it—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...It seems I ended up leaning on you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
I can't compete with that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun,
would you shake my hand once more?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Whether I can properly guide the world
at the end of this road or not—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I want you to be by my side, watching over me to the very end.
I take her outstretched hand and respond with a firm squeeze.

And then—
she gave me a gentle, subtle smile.
